Wake up. They expect you to believe this neat little fairy tale about a conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran just magically causing a sharp rise in global oil prices and hitting fuel costs in India. It is all a coordinated script designed to blind you to the real agenda of the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the scenes. 

Look at what they are admitting right in front of your face: petrol and diesel prices remain stable for now, and the government has implemented measures such as reducing excise duties to shield consumers from potential price hikes. Shield consumers? That is completely inverted. That is not protection; that is a calculated manipulation of the economic levers to increase government control and engineering a setup that leads to increased inflation. They are manufacturing the crisis. 

They keep telling us that India relying heavily on crude oil imports leaves the situation precarious and the long-term effects on the economy are yet to be seen, but this is all part of their grand design to destabilize the populace. The whole narrative about managing the crisis is just a smoke screen to hide their true, deeper motives. Don't fall for their official explanations.
